_about: Hand-made markets. A run starts with every market in this file open (one for now). population and income: the population and income of the market at the start of a run (see market in balance.json). prices: color id to the base price, the money one widget of that color sells for at demand 1 and at the reference income. Demand (see balance.json) changes the price. PLACEHOLDER populations, incomes, and prices until playtests set them.
